ترتضخن (form VIII)
# تَرْتَضِخْنَ (tartaḍiḵna) /tar.ta.dˤix.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# تُرْتَضَخْنَ (turtaḍaḵna) /tur.ta.dˤax.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
